definition: גֹּ֫פֶר noun [masculine] gopher , only in עֲצֵיגֹּֿפֶר Gen 6:14 ( P ), wood of which the ark was made (word dubious; Thes compare כֹּפֶר & so Rob Ges (hence ' pitch-wood , resinous wood'), compare Di ; Lag Semitica i. 64 ; Symmict. ii. 93, BN 217 ff. thinks word not original, but inferred from גפרית , and substituted here for גפרית by copyist, or editor. compare following).
